params.message:
Take Gentells Standard 0.19.0: Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg under Benelux

The Standard now has countries under Benelux, so the region tree has a third
level. A continent is a region at the top with regions under it; Benelux
holds countries and is not one (it had become a fifth continent). The trend
origin reads a region's continent however deep, the classifier is told to
use Benelux only for something about its countries together, and a source
list that says België, Vlaanderen or Nederland maps to the country.

Signals classified from here on carry the country; what was tagged Benelux
stays Benelux, and a filter on Benelux finds both.

Portal: Gentells herkent België en Nederland nu als eigen regio voor nieuwe signalen.
